# Marco D'Antonio — Portfolio & personAI (full reference)

> One-page portfolio and AI assistant for Marco D'Antonio, full-stack developer & AI engineer.
> Stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, Three.js, Lenis, Cloudflare Workers AI.
> Deployed on Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext.
> Live at: https://marcodantonio.it

---

## Architecture

Two locale routes: `/` (Italian) and `/en` (English). Sections stacked in `app/(it)/page.tsx` and `app/(en)/en/page.tsx`, anchor-navigated:
`#about` → `#education` → `#skills` → `#projects` → `#experience` → `#contact`

Only dynamic route: `/api/personai` — RAG chat powered by Cloudflare Workers AI.

---

## File map

```
app/
  (it)/layout.tsx    # Italian root HTML/body shell + lang="it"
  (it)/page.tsx      # Root Italian page: all sections
  (it)/opengraph-image.tsx  # Italian OG preview generator
  (it)/twitter-image.tsx     # Italian Twitter preview generator
  (en)/layout.tsx    # English root HTML/body shell + lang="en"
  (en)/en/page.tsx   # English locale page
  (en)/en/opengraph-image.tsx  # English OG preview generator
  (en)/en/twitter-image.tsx     # English Twitter preview generator
  design-system.css  # All global tokens, motion classes, component CSS
  api/personai/      # POST handler for AI chat

components/
  intro.tsx          # Hero: particle canvas + chat widget + parallax-out
  about.tsx          # Bio + profile.json terminal card
  education.tsx      # Degrees + radar arc SVG
  skills.tsx         # 3D Fibonacci sphere with tagged skills
  projects-rail.tsx  # Drag-scroll holographic card rail
  experience.tsx     # Timeline with animated SVG line draw
  contact.tsx        # Email form + social links + Turnstile
  kinetic-heading.tsx  # Reusable section title (per-word mask reveal)
  marquee.tsx        # Infinite tech-stack ticker
  grain-overlay.tsx  # Fixed film-grain noise layer
  system/
    copy.tsx           # Eyebrow text primitive
    spotlight-section.tsx  # Full-width section wrapper with cursor glow
    smooth-scroll.tsx      # Lenis smooth-scroll provider
  ui/                # shadcn base: button, input, textarea, badge

content/
  i18n.ts            # Bilingual dictionary (IT + EN) — ALL UI strings
  knowledge/         # personAI knowledge base
  site.ts            # Site metadata

lib/
  data.ts            # Projects, skills, experiences (feeds i18n + personAI)
  motion.ts          # Motion tokens + prefersReducedMotion()
  scroll-signal.ts   # Shared single-rAF scroll listener
  personai.ts        # RAG retrieval + Workers AI prompt/response
  cloudflare.ts      # getCloudflareContext() wrapper
  utils.ts           # cn(), validateString(), getErrorMessage()

context/
  theme-context.tsx    # Light/dark + localStorage
  language-context.tsx # IT/EN toggle + localStorage + URL routing

actions/
  sendEmail.ts       # Server action: Turnstile validation + Resend email

public/
  portrait.jpg       # Shared portrait asset used by JSON-LD and content

app/
  robots.ts          # robots.txt
  sitemap.ts         # sitemap.xml
  not-found.tsx      # 404 page
```

---

## Layout pattern for new sections

```tsx
// In app/(it)/page.tsx or app/(en)/en/page.tsx
<SpotlightSection id="sectionid" className="py-24 sm:py-28">
  <Container>
    <YourSection />
  </Container>
</SpotlightSection>

// In components/your-section.tsx
export default function YourSection() {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <KineticHeading eyebrow={t.yoursection.label} text={t.yoursection.title} />
      {/* content */}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Add section ID to `SECTIONS` array in `components/header.tsx` for nav highlighting.
Add IT + EN strings to `content/i18n.ts`.

---

## Design tokens (app/design-system.css)

```css
/* Colors */
--background, --surface, --foreground
--accent, --accent-soft
--copy-default, --copy-muted, --copy-soft
--line, --line-subtle

/* Motion */
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
--ease-inout: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)
--dur-fast: 0.35s
--dur-base: 0.6s
--dur-slow: 0.85s
```

---

## Scroll animation pattern

ONE shared rAF listener. All scroll-linked work subscribes here:

```tsx
import { subscribeScroll } from "@/lib/scroll-signal";

useEffect(() => {
  return subscribeScroll(() => {
    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
    const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rect.top / window.innerHeight));
    element.style.opacity = `${1 - progress}`;
  });
}, []);
```

Never add your own `addEventListener('scroll')`.

---

## i18n pattern

```ts
// content/i18n.ts
type Copy = {
  mysection: { label: string; title: string; description: string }
}
dictionary.it = { mysection: { label: "// N — label", title: "Titolo", description: "..." } }
dictionary.en = { mysection: { label: "// N — label", title: "Title", description: "..." } }

// In component
const { t } = useLanguage();
<KineticHeading eyebrow={t.mysection.label} text={t.mysection.title} />
```

---

## personAI

RAG chat widget embedded in the hero. Speaks about Marco in third person to recruiters/visitors.

- **Widget**: `components/hero-mini-chat.tsx`
- **API**: `app/api/personai/route.ts` — validates input + lang, calls `answerPersonAIQuestion`
- **Logic**: `lib/personai.ts` — keyword retrieval → messages format → Workers AI → JSON parse
- **Model**: `@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct` (fixed)
- **Output**: `response_format: { type: "json_schema" }` → `{ "answer": "..." }`
- **Language**: passed explicitly as `lang: "it" | "en"` from UI → system message instruction

Knowledge sources:
- `portfolioDocuments` built at runtime from `lib/data.ts` (profile, projects, skills, experience)
- `content/knowledge/generated-cv.ts` — CV text

---

## Non-negotiables

- Do NOT add section routes (no `/about`, `/projects`, `/experience`, `/contact`)
- `/en` is the approved English locale route
- Do NOT reintroduce: `.surface-card`, `.section-copy`, `.eyebrow`, `ScrambleText`, `react-parallax-tilt`
- Do NOT add custom scroll listeners — use `lib/scroll-signal`
- Do NOT hardcode UI strings — use `content/i18n.ts`
- DO run `npm run lint && npm run build` after every change

---

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Local dev (port 3000)
npm run lint         # ESLint
npm run build        # Production build
npm run preview      # Cloudflare OpenNext preview (tests CF bindings)
npm run deploy       # Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
```
